summary: Bridgewater Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 results via Item 2.02 and furnishing an earnings presentation under Regulation FD (Item 7.01). Item 8.01 discloses a board-declared quarterly cash dividend on the 5.875% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series A of $36.72 per share, or $0.3672 per depositary share (Nasdaq: BWBBP), payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 13, 2026. No transactional special situation is present; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a deal or capital-returns event beyond ordinary preferred dividends.
